# [Blog Volt](https://github.com/RaisFast/raisfast)

> A bold, brutalist blog template powered by RaisFast — the Rust-powered high-performance BaaS and headless CMS.

## What is Blog Volt?

Blog Volt is a high-energy, brutalist blog template that demonstrates the content management capabilities of RaisFast. It features mono-spaced typography, thick borders, no border radius, all-caps headings, category and tag navigation, and full SEO optimization. Form follows function.

## Key Features

- Server-side rendering with Next.js App Router
- Brutalist design: mono font, thick borders, all-caps, no curves
- Category and tag-based navigation
- Full-text search
- SEO: Open Graph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD (Article), sitemap.xml, robots.txt, canonical
- Responsive design with mobile-first approach

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Fonts**: Geist Mono
- **API**: RaisFast SDK (@raisfast/sdk)

## API Endpoints Used

- `GET /api/v1/posts` — Post listing with pagination
- `GET /api/v1/posts/:slug` — Post detail by slug
- `GET /api/v1/categories` — Category listing
- `GET /api/v1/tags` — Tag listing

## Getting Started

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env.local
npm run dev
```
